name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle designed to travel on no more than three wheels and capable of more than 35 mph; an electric two-wheeler too fast or powerful to be a moped lands here, as does a moped ridden past 35 mph.

restrictions.rule: No more than three wheels on the ground and capable of more than 35 mph (Code of Virginia §46.2-100)
A moped with a motor over 1,500 watts is titled as a motorcycle, and a moped ridden faster than 35 mph is treated as one
Virginia's motor-driven cycle category covers only small gasoline engines, so an electric light motorcycle is a moped or a motorcycle (Code of Virginia §46.2-100)
Riders need a driver's license with a Class M designation, or a motorcycle learner's permit
Every rider and passenger must wear an approved helmet, and the operator a face shield, safety glasses or goggles unless it has an approved windshield
Titled and registered with the DMV with motorcycle plates, and must meet the insurance and safety inspection requirements
An off-road motorcycle converted for road use must be certified to federal motor vehicle safety standards and titled and registered as a motorcycle before it's ridden on the road
